host_galaxy.comment:
Savaglio+2009: GRB type in Table 1: long. Table 2 is pseudophotometry in AB magnitudes, corrected for Galactic extinction; it is not a complete list of all original observed photometry. No host coordinates, redshift uncertainty, or redshift method are reported in Tables 1-2.
Perley+2013: Perley+2013 Tables 1–2 identified host; Redshift method as published: nonphotometric_in_VizieR; Table 1 says GRB or host. Host coordinates use the RAH/DEH columns, not the afterglow RAJ2000/DEJ2000 columns. Table 3 magnitudes are uncorrected for foreground Galactic extinction; measurement errors are 1 sigma. Figure 3 describes the upper limits as 2 sigma.
Krühler+2015: Host emission-line spectroscopy from the X-shooter sample; no per-source redshift uncertainty is stated in the CDS table. Coordinates are J2000 eq_FK5 positions from Simbad via the CDS/VizieR table, not new astrometry measured by this paper. The paper states that fluxes, spectra, and photometry are corrected for Galactic foreground reddening; incidental AB magnitudes therefore have gext_corr=true.
Savaglio+2009: Source access: arXiv v3 Table 1–2 TeX was used after the IOP VoR/MRT route was blocked; this is a documented substitution.
Krühler+2015: Source access: CDS/VizieR J/A+A/581/A125 plus arXiv HTML for paper-only values and appendices; the A&A full-text route returned 403.
Merged-field decision: host coordinates taken from Perley+2013 according to the direct-measurement priority rule.
Merged-field decision: redshift, error, and type taken as one tuple from Krühler+2015 according to the recency/method priority rule.
